notes.title: Bug Fix Update - No More Falling Through!
notes.content:
Hey Raiders!

We’ve just released a small but important bug fix for Stealth Raider. Some players reported falling through the environment under specific circumstances, so we’ve patched things up to keep you safe and focused on the adventure!

Here’s what’s fixed in this update:

Resolved Falling Issue: Players will no longer fall through the environment. Now, you can explore each level with confidence!
Improved Stability: We’ve also made minor improvements to enhance the overall stability of the game.
Thank you for your feedback and support. If you encounter any other issues, please let us know in the community forum!

Happy raiding, and enjoy the smoother experience! 🏆
